## Objective
- Expand the existing GOREPIT game into a playable game with sandbox and area modes, multiple maps, a merchant economy, starting pistol, and kill animations.

## Requirements
- Sandbox mode includes the existing 4×4 room plus an island in the sea with a house and a skyscraper map.
- Area mode includes a two-story run-down church, bloodied walls, gore enemies coming through walls, most rooms boarded off, and a bloody smashed stake of Jesus Christ at the entrance.
- Start with a pistol; killing gore enemies earns money to spend at a merchant on weapons.
- Add kill animations for arena and sandbox modes.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game structure and current implementation.

### Active
- Implement all requested gameplay, maps, combat, economy, and mode-selection features.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add mode/map selection UI and adapt the scene-building code in `src/main.js` for the requested maps.
2. Implement pistol combat, kill rewards, merchant purchases, and mode-specific enemy behavior/animations.
3. Add church, island-house, and skyscraper environments and verify the game in-browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing game HUD and start/death overlays.
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene setup, input, combat loop, HUD, and game lifecycle.
- `src/npc.js`: Gore enemy model, chasing/combat logic, and death animation.
- `src/weapons.js`: Existing weapon definitions and world/view weapon meshes.
- `styles.css`: Existing HUD, overlays, touch controls, and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Existing game is a browser-based Three.js first-person arena with a 4×4 room, melee weapons, gore enemies, and touch controls.
- No files have been changed; implementation has not started.

## Objective
- Expand GOREPIT into a playable game with sandbox and area modes, new maps, pistol combat, a merchant economy, and kill animations.

## Requirements
- Sandbox includes the existing 4×4 room, an island with a house, and a skyscraper map.
- Area mode is a run-down, two-story church with bloodied walls, gore enemies entering through walls, most rooms boarded off, and a bloody smashed stake of Jesus Christ at the entrance.
- Start with a pistol; killing gore enemies earns money to spend at a merchant on weapons.
- Add kill animations for arena and sandbox modes.
- Make reasonable assumptions, do not ask clarifying questions, and briefly note assumptions on completion.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions recorded.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected existing Three.js gameplay, UI, NPC, weapon, audio, and quality code.
- Created `src/world.js` with initial geometry for the church, island-house, skyscraper, and 4×4 maps.

### Active
- Integrate `src/world.js` with `src/main.js`, including mode/map selection, world lifecycle, and map-specific movement and collision.
- Implement pistol combat, kill rewards, merchant purchases, and mode-specific enemy behavior.
- Verify and fix map geometry, movement/collision, spawning, and gameplay.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add start-screen mode/map selection and connect world construction/lifecycle in `src/main.js`.
2. Add pistol, kill rewards, merchant purchasing, and corresponding HUD/UI.
3. Adapt enemy spawning and movement, player/NPC/weapon collision, and kill animations to each map; test gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Scene setup, combat loop, HUD, input, and lifecycle; primary integration point.
- `src/world.js`: Initial map geometry module returning `{ root, solid, breachPoints, bounds, ground, title, sky, fog }`.
- `src/npc.js`: Enemy behavior, movement bounds, and death animation.
- `src/weapons.js`: Existing melee weapon definitions, meshes, and pickups.
- `index.html`: Existing HUD and start/death overlays.
- `styles.css`: HUD, overlay, touch-control, and responsive styling.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural sound effects, potentially relevant for pistol and merchant feedback.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/world.js` is the only file created in the latest implementation attempt.
- `src/main.js` still builds only the original arena; no callers use `src/world.js` yet.
- `src/world.js` currently returns empty `solid` lists for all maps, so collision support remains to be implemented.
- Existing NPC movement, weapon projectile bounds, and player movement assume a small 4×4 arena.
- `src/world.js` skyscraper branch references `darken(concrete)`, which currently just returns its argument.

- Start with a pistol; killing gore enemies earns money to spend at a merchant on weapons.
- Add kill animations for arena and sandbox modes.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions recorded.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/world.js` contains initial geometry for the church, island-house, skyscraper, and 4×4 maps, including church breaches, boarded areas, blood streaks, and a broken cross-like stake.

- Implement pistol combat, kill rewards, merchant purchases, and HUD/UI.

### Blocked
- (none)

2. Add pistol, kill rewards, merchant purchasing, and corresponding HUD/UI.

- `src/main.js`: Scene setup, combat loop, HUD, input, and lifecycle; primary integration point.

- `index.html`: HUD and start/death overlays.
- `styles.css`: HUD, overlay, touch-control, and responsive styling.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural sound effects, potentially relevant for pistol and merchant feedback.

- `src/main.js` currently starts with fists and melee weapons; it has no pistol, money, or merchant system.
- `src/npc.js` already includes a death animation, but map-specific bounds and sandbox/area behavior are not integrated.

## Objective
- Expand GOREPIT into a playable game with arena, sandbox, and area modes, varied maps, pistol combat, merchant purchases, and kill animations.

## Requirements
- Sandbox maps: a 4×4 room, an island with a house, and a skyscraper.
- Area mode: a run-down, two-story church with bloodied walls, gore enemies entering through wall breaches, boarded-off rooms, and a smashed stake at the entrance.
- Start with a pistol; kills earn money to spend at a merchant on weapons.
- Add kill animations for arena and sandbox modes.

## Decisions
- Kills pay $25; merchant prices are $60 for a pickaxe and $40 for a hatchet.
- Start screen selects arena, sandbox, or area; sandbox map choices are the 4×4 room, island, and skyscraper.
- Default sidearm is free.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has mode/map selectors, cash HUD, merchant markup, and control hints.
- `src/audio.js` has procedural pistol audio.
- `src/world.js` builds church, island, tower, and 4×4 room geometry.
- `src/npc.js` includes NPC death animations.
- `src/main.js` has pistol firing logic, kill rewards, `configureWorld()`, `clearNPCs()`, and `resetRun()` scaffolding.
- Added `src/collision.js` with `resolveWorldPosition()` for bounds and solid-box collision resolution.

### Active
- Wire selector change handlers and call `resetRun()` from start/restart; ensure old weapon groups are removed before clearing `weapons`.
- Implement merchant open/close, purchases, affordability feedback, weapon equipping, and `B` shortcut; `refreshShop()` is called but undefined.
- Integrate generalized bounds/collision into player, NPC, and thrown-weapon movement; spawn area enemies at church breach points.
- Style selector and merchant UI, then test modes, maps, combat, kills, and purchases.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Wire selector events and call `resetRun()` on start/restart; fix weapon-group cleanup and ensure respawn honors the selected world.
2. Implement merchant interactions and purchases, including charging cash and equipping purchased weapons.
3. Generalize player/NPC/weapon movement bounds, use church breach points for area spawning, and add needed collision handling.
4. Style the selectors and merchant; test gameplay across modes, maps, combat, and purchases.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: World setup, selectors, movement, combat, cash, merchant, lifecycle, and input.
- `src/world.js`: Map builders; returns `{ root, solid, breachPoints, bounds, ground, title, sky, fog }`.
- `src/collision.js`: New helper for resolving actor positions against map bounds and solid boxes.
- `src/npc.js`: NPC behavior, death animation, and current arena-specific clamping.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon drops and current arena bounds for thrown weapons.
- `index.html`: Mode/map selectors, merchant, cash HUD, and controls.
- `styles.css`: Needs selector and merchant UI styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `index.html`, `src/audio.js`, and `src/main.js` are modified; `src/world.js` and `src/collision.js` are untracked.
- `configureWorld()` is not called from start/restart; selectors have no change handlers; merchant markup has no interaction wiring.
- `resetRun()` sets `weapons = []` before `configureWorld()` can remove old weapon groups, potentially leaving them in the scene.
- Player movement still clamps to ±1.76; `GoreNPC.clampArena()` clamps to ±1.66; thrown weapons clamp to ±1.9.
- `world.solid` is empty in current map builders; church breach points are defined but unused for spawning; `darken()` is a no-op.
- Pistol fires through the `!heldWeapon` attack path; `equipped` is initialized to `'pistol'`, while `heldWeapon` starts null.
- `startGame()` spawns an NPC but does not reset the run; respawn resets to arena coordinates and does not reset cash.

- Expand GOREPIT into a playable game with arena, sandbox, and area modes, varied maps, pistol combat, merchant purchases, and kill animations.

## Requirements
- Sandbox maps: a 4×4 room, an island with a house, and a skyscraper.
- Area mode: a run-down, two-story church with bloodied walls, wall breaches for gore enemies, boarded-off rooms, and a smashed stake at the entrance.
- Start with a pistol; kills earn money to spend at a merchant on weapons.
- Add kill animations for arena and sandbox modes.

## Decisions
- Kills pay $25; merchant prices are $60 for a pickaxe and $40 for a hatchet.
- Start screen selects arena, sandbox, or area; sandbox map choices are the 4×4 room, island, and skyscraper.
- Default sidearm is free.

## Work State

### Completed
- `index.html` has mode/map selectors, cash HUD, merchant markup, and control hints.
- `src/audio.js` has procedural pistol audio.
- `src/world.js` builds church, island, tower, and 4×4 room geometry, with world bounds and breach-point data.
- `src/npc.js` includes NPC death animations.
- `src/collision.js` provides `resolveWorldPosition()` for bounds and solid-box collision resolution.
- `src/main.js` has pistol firing, kill rewards, world setup, NPC cleanup, and run-reset scaffolding; imports `resolveWorldPosition()`.

### Active
- Wire selector change handlers and call `resetRun()` from start/restart; remove old weapon groups before clearing `weapons`.
- Implement merchant open/close, purchases, affordability feedback, weapon equipping, and `B` shortcut; `refreshShop()` is called but undefined.
- Integrate generalized bounds/collision into player, NPC, and thrown-weapon movement; spawn area enemies at church breach points.
- Style selector and merchant UI, then test modes, maps, combat, and purchases.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Wire selector events and call `resetRun()` from start/restart; fix weapon-group cleanup and ensure respawn honors the selected world.
2. Implement merchant interactions and purchases, including charging cash and equipping purchased weapons.
3. Generalize player/NPC/weapon movement bounds, use church breach points for area spawning, and add needed collision handling.
4. Style the selectors and merchant; test gameplay across modes, maps, combat, and purchases.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: World setup, selectors, movement, combat, cash, merchant, lifecycle, and input.
- `src/world.js`: Map builders; returns `{ root, solid, breachPoints, bounds, ground, title, sky, fog }`.
- `src/collision.js`: Helper for resolving actor positions against map bounds and solid boxes.
- `src/npc.js`: NPC behavior, death animation, and current arena-specific clamping.
- `src/weapons.js`: Weapon drops and current arena bounds for thrown weapons.
- `index.html`: Mode/map selectors, merchant, cash HUD, and controls.
- `styles.css`: Needs selector and merchant UI styling.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural pistol audio.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `index.html`, `src/audio.js`, and `src/main.js` are modified; `src/world.js` and `src/collision.js` are untracked.
- `configureWorld()` is not called from start/restart; selectors have no change handlers; merchant markup has no interaction wiring.
- `resetRun()` sets `weapons = []` before `configureWorld()` can remove old weapon groups, potentially leaving them in the scene.
- Player movement still clamps to ±1.76; `GoreNPC.clampArena()` clamps to ±1.66; thrown weapons clamp to ±1.9.
- `world.solid` is empty in current map builders; church breach points are defined but unused for spawning; `darken()` is a no-op.
- Pistol fires through the `!heldWeapon` attack path; `equipped` is initialized to `'pistol'`, while `heldWeapon` starts null.
- `startGame()` spawns an NPC but does not reset the run; respawn resets to arena coordinates and does not reset cash.
